name: Nezaton AI Chatbot
author: nezaton

sections.description:
Nezaton AI Chatbot adds your Nezaton chat widget to every page of your WordPress site.

The AI answers from your own FAQs, product catalog and business documents. It can capture leads, book appointments for service businesses, take orders for product businesses and hand over to a human agent when needed.

You set up the AI itself in your Nezaton dashboard. This plugin only places the widget on your site.

You need a Nezaton account. Nezaton is a paid service with a free trial. The plugin does not work without an account.

Features

  • Paste your Product ID, and the widget appears on your site
  • Turn the widget on or off
  • Hide the widget on chosen pages

External services

This plugin loads a script from the Nezaton service and connects your site’s visitors to it.

  • Service: Nezaton (https://nezaton.com)
  • What is loaded: https://nezaton.com/widget.js, on every front-end page where the widget is enabled.
  • What is sent: when a visitor opens the chat, the messages they type, and technical data such as their IP address and browser details, are sent to Nezaton so the AI can reply.
  • Terms of Service: https://nezaton.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://nezaton.com/privacy

Site owners should mention this in their own privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin or install it from the Plugins screen, then activate it.
  2. Go to Settings, then Nezaton.
  3. Paste your Product ID from your Nezaton dashboard and save.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Product ID?

In your Nezaton dashboard, open your Website AI product, then Settings, General.

Does it work without a Nezaton account?

No. You need an account to create the AI product.

The widget doesn’t appear.

Check that the box is ticked, the Product ID is correct, and your domain is allowed in your Nezaton product’s Security settings.
